titolo: Nvidia leader steps down as firm launches $500 B AI compute financing partnership
descr: Jensen Huang resigns amid espionage scandal; Nvidia teams with six financiers to fund AI infrastructure worth over $500 billion.
paragrafi: Nvidia’s co‑founder and longtime CEO Jensen Huang announced his resignation following a series of scandals.
The New York Times reported on October 29 that a Chinese spy plot targeted Huang, linking him to Alice Huang of Megaspeed, a company under U.S. trade‑restriction investigation.
The Times later said Alice Huang was recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security on November 6, and Huang admitted to an extramarital affair on November 8, prompting a board investigation.
"NVIDIA has reached an important milestone," said Jensen Huang, noting that the new financing platforms will turn Nvidia compute into an investable asset class.
perche: The financing aims to expand AI compute capacity and broaden access to Nvidia‑based infrastructure, which could lower hardware costs for developers. Greater compute availability may benefit both enterprise users and hobbyists who run free or local models such as Kimi K3, Kimi K3.1 Pro, GLM‑5.3 and others that currently lead the free chat‑model rankings.
